description.value: D-Plus Pizza is a locally owned and operated chain that grew from a single Fraser Valley shop called D Hut Pizza into five locations across Surrey and Delta, BC, distinguished by a menu that blends classic pizza with Indian cuisine staples such as channa bathura, donairs, and paneer pizza. The chain built its reputation on fresh ingredients, all-natural cheeses, and daily value specials. A touring cyclist stopping here would encounter a casual, takeout-and-delivery-oriented restaurant with a broad and eclectic menu.
